message: 素敵な粗品
November--a month full of all sorts of events--is down to its final few days. We're finally about to welcome December, the month of the actual Holy Night Festival.
My heart is pounding. It feels just like sitting in front of a face-down test paper, waiting for the teacher to say "Begin."
The Student Council and the Crusaders! I have to give my all for both of them!!

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, you've got a serious look on your face again~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Th-Th-That's not true at all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, if you lie to me, you're gonna get a scolding, okay? We're just out shopping for tea leaves today, got it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, let's take it easy.」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, do you really get it, I wonder~?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not that there's only one month left until the Holy Night Festival--it's that we still have a whole month! Got it?」

name: Synn
message: 「So you mean if I keep myself all wound up right now, my body won't hold out until the big day.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem! Exactly right. You should listen to your advisor.」
Chatting idly with Ria-senpai, we approach the entrance to the shopping district.

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm, hmmm~. You're still hiding something... aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's not that...」
Something feels slightly off.
I want to talk to her honestly about it, but I haven't even figured out what's causing this sense of disharmony myself.

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, would you have preferred being with everyone else instead of alone with just me?」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Please don't tease me like Helena-san does.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph! I'm nothing like my big sister!」
Walking alone with Ria-senpai, having the exact same kind of conversation as always--
Alone? Ah... I get it! It's because Paqy, who normally hits on Ria-senpai with every trick in the book, is unusually quiet today of all days! What's going on?
At the intersection in front of the Shiokumi Shopping District, we bump right into Azel. The crosswalk light happens to be red.

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my? What a coincidence, Azel-san. Hello♪」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you out shopping too, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right. I came all the way out here looking for Vandine Jelly.」

name: Azel
message: 「Prier is sold out of far too many items... How utterly inefficient...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then come to the supermarket with us.」

name: Ria
message: 「Boo. So you really didn't want to be alone with just me, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-S-S-S-Senpai, come on!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahahahaha♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, watch out! The light's still red!!」
As if grabbing a mischievous cat, I seize Azel by the collar and forcibly haul her back onto the sidewalk.

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaaaaaah!?」
A close call. A car speeds past, less than ten centimeters away from Azel and me.
The driver glares at us. We're completely in the wrong here.

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm just glad you're safe~」

name: Azel
message: 「Why did you shout so loudly?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you just pulled a reckless stunt, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「? You two were standing around wasting time, so I merely went ahead.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not allowed to cross until the light turns green!」

name: Azel
message: 「I prefer red over green.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not the issue here!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... aah, what I said about wanting to be alone with Synn-kun wasn't serious, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right, of course. By the way, that actually hurts a little.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understood.」

name: Ria
message: 「Aha, ahahaha... M-Maybe I need to get better at telling jokes like Big Sis, huh?」
While I was busy scolding Azel, the traffic light went from red to green, and then right back to red again.

name: Ria
message: 「Here, a reward for you, Synn-kun. Some chewing gum I got from Akane-chan♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, that's an unusual brand. Thank you very much.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, take out your stamp card. I'm gonna stamp it for that great job you just did.\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Aaalright♪ Let's make it an extra-generous bonus!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ta-daaa! It's all filled up!」

name: Azel
message: 「What is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「When all the stamp spaces get filled, something good happens!」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go, Synn-kun. Your prizes are a ballpoint pen, a binder clip, and some chewing gum.\s04」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understood.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Th-Thank you very much.」
They look like freebies from a bank.
While thanking her, I divide the chewing gum into three equal pieces and hand them to Ria-senpai and Azel.

name: Sally
message: 「Sniff, sniff, sniff. Hey, hey, something smells sweet! What is that, what is it?」

name: Sally
message: 「Eek, Azel... Shiver, shiver, tremble, tremble.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan?」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey, I have no need for this 'gum' or whatever it is. Give it to that demon.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, I don't mind, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「No can do, Synn-kun. Azel-san has to give it to her herself, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so. Very well.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hyoeeeeh!?」
Just as I had done, Azel hands all of her chewing gum over to Sally-chan.

name: Sally
message: 「Azel...?」

name: Sally
message: 「Thanks for the treat! Nom, nom, nom.」

name: Sally
message: 「Munch, munch, munch, it's yummy, but this is a weird sweet, chew, chew, chew.」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be her first time eating gum?」

name: Sally
message: 「Puff~?」

name: Sally
message: 「Jolt!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Thud, spinny-spin~\s07」

name: Sally
message: 「Aha! So you can smile too, Azel♪」

name: Azel
message: 「...The light's green. Let's go.」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee.」
With Sally-chan included, our group had grown to four before we knew it, and we finally crossed the crosswalk.
Just like Senpai promised, something really good did happen.
